stories.title: Two Buckley roads shut following road traffic collision
stories.summary: Springfield Road and Well Street in Buckley are closed following a road traffic collision. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team posted an alert on Tuesday morning saying both roads were shut. Officers are asking drivers to avoid the area. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council still waiting to learn how much Welsh Government funding it will receive towards a forecast £27.8m gap for 2027-28.
